verdict.rationale: Document AI returns its results in open, portable formats: markdown text, markdown or HTML tables, and structured block and annotation data. An on-prem deployment option also reduces lock-in. However, nothing in the evidence documents a way to export everything held on the platform (uploaded files, account data, history) or a documented exit path. Missing for 10: bulk or account-level data export, export of uploaded and stored files, documented migration or exit process, independent corroboration of portability.
